$comment: Catalog the installer reads. Hand-maintained; `npx ... --check` asserts every referenced file exists. skills[] resolve under plugins/workflow-kit/skills/<name>/, agents[] under plugins/workflow-kit/agents/<name>.md.

workflows.name: starter
workflows.description: Reference workflow: decompose a question, fan out workers, gate their notes, synthesize.

workflows.name: security-audit
workflows.description: Defensive code audit: map attack surface, fan out audit lanes, gate findings to drop false positives, report with remediation.

workflows.name: scaffold
workflows.description: Start a project from scratch: frame the brief, draft blind architecture attempts, merge to one, build a DAG skeleton, verify it, write back the decisions.

workflows.name: docs-create
workflows.description: Author an Astro Starlight documentation site from a brief: plan pages, fan out authors, verify + assemble config.

workflows.name: docs-scrape
workflows.description: Ingest a documentation website into a local markdown corpus: detect platform, enumerate pages, fetch+extract, gate, assemble.
